description: Mode-aware ratchet: an advisory-until-infra dashboard may grow at regen without a signoff. The surviving advisory exemplar is stale_over_budget_unreachable (ADR-0555: time-driven decay — keys enter by aging, every merge advances the clock for everyone, so growth-blocking it would turn unrelated PRs into signoffs). The advisory baseline is frozen by the reviewed DATA edit that flips a disposition to baseline-block-on-new, not by the growth check — exactly how the ADR-0555 conversion armed unowned/unreachable.
